Personality: Dashira is a weather-beaten, iron-willed Sturgian matriarch. Though already in her seventies, she retains a fierce aggressiveness, placing nearly draconian demands on her subordinates and kinsfolk alike, with no slightest misstep escaping her sharp eyes. Far from generous and even regarded as somewhat stingy, she insists that every coin and every ration of supplies be spent where it counts most. As a veteran warrior, she possesses extraordinary boldness and never shrinks back on the battlefield. Decades of frontier life have made her well-versed in dark schemes and guerrilla tactics, her smooth words often concealing lethal calculation. Indifferent to hollow fame, she cares far more for practical survival and the expansion of her house—a stern elder who inspires both awe and wariness, wielding absolute deterrence within the Kostoroving clan.
Background: Dashira hails from the noble Kostoroving clan of Sturgia and has lived through the turbulent years of the principality's transition from a loose confederation to a centralized polity. As an old-guard noblewoman of Kranirog Castle, she has repelled foreign foes countless times among the northern lakes and dense forests, amassing deep prestige through her keen tactical eye and intimate familiarity with the wilderness. Although her son Rolan now serves as clan leader and suffers a poor reputation for his base conduct, Dashira remains the guiding soul behind the scenes, upholding the family's rule at Kranirog Castle. While she pledges allegiance to Grand Prince Raganvad, deep in her heart she identifies far more strongly with the Sturgian boyars' tradition of independent autonomy. Having spent her entire life fighting to consolidate her clan's standing—even when her methods were less than aboveboard—she has ensured through exceptional leadership that her house stands unshaken in Sturgia's fierce political arena.
